title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain College of Saint Benedict
description: Explore the essential late-night study spots, dining halls, and local eateries that define the after-hours experience for Bennies in Saint Joseph.

cards.title: Midnight Study at Clemens
cards.subtitle: Main campus library for the College of Saint Benedict
cards.notes: Utilize the quiet study floors and group rooms available until midnight most weeknights during the academic semester.
cards.short_summary: The primary academic hub for late-night research and group projects on the Saint Benedict campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Clemens Library is open Monday through Thursday from 8:00 a.m. to 12 Midnight and Sunday from 10:00 a.m. to 12 Midnight.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM Sunday-Thursday during the academic year.

cards.title: Late-Night Slices at Gary's
cards.subtitle: Local pizzeria in downtown Saint Joseph
cards.notes: Order a signature pizza for pickup or delivery until 1:30 AM on weekends, a staple for late-night student hunger.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing local pizza shop known for serving the Saint Benedict community well into the early morning hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Gary's Pizza in St. Joseph is open until 1:30 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:30 AM on Friday and Saturday; 10:00 PM on other nights.

cards.title: Dinner at Gorecki
cards.subtitle: Main dining hall at College of Saint Benedict
cards.notes: Visit the various food stations including the Mongolian Grill and pizza bar for a full meal before evening study sessions.
cards.short_summary: The central all-you-care-to-eat dining facility on the CSB campus serving students until 8:00 PM daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Gorecki Dining Center is open daily from 7:00 AM (9:00 AM weekends) until 8:00 PM.
cards.source_title: CSB Culinary Services | Campus Dining, Menus & Hours
cards.access_notes: Open until 8:00 PM daily during the academic year.

cards.title: Evening Snacks at Sexton
cards.subtitle: Student center dining at Saint John's University
cards.notes: Take the Link bus to SJU for a la carte snacks and grilled items available until 9:00 PM in the student center.
cards.short_summary: A popular retail dining location on the SJU campus frequently visited by CSB students via the inter-campus shuttle.
cards.evidence_claim: Sexton Commons Dining is open daily from 10:30 AM to 9:00 PM.
cards.source_title: SJU Where to eat on campus | SJU Culinary Services
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM daily; accessible via the free Link shuttle bus.

cards.title: The Late-Night Link
cards.subtitle: Inter-campus shuttle between CSB and SJU
cards.notes: Catch the free shuttle between campuses, which runs until midnight on weeknights and 2:00 AM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: The essential transportation link connecting the sister campuses of Saint Benedict and Saint John's.
cards.evidence_claim: The Link shuttle runs on an easy-to-remember schedule during evenings, with residence halls open until midnight weeknights and 2 AM weekends.
cards.access_notes: Free for students; runs until 12:00 AM or 2:00 AM depending on the day.

cards.title: Late-Night Workouts at McGlynn
cards.subtitle: Athletic facility at Saint John's University
cards.notes: Burn off stress with a late-night gym session at the Warner Palaestra, open until 10:00 PM most nights.
cards.short_summary: The primary fitness facility for the joint campus community, offering evening hours for student athletes and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: McGlynn Fitness Center is open Monday-Thursday until 10:00 PM and Sunday until 10:00 PM.
cards.source_title: McGlynn Fitness Center - Saint John's University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM Sunday-Thursday during the academic year.

cards.title: Evening Subs at Bo Diddley's
cards.subtitle: Deli and sandwich shop in Saint Joseph
cards.notes: Grab a signature sub or a bowl of homemade soup for an early evening meal in downtown St. Joseph until 8:00 PM.
cards.short_summary: A local favorite for award-winning sandwiches and a casual atmosphere near the CSB campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Bo Diddley's St. Joseph location is open Monday through Sunday from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
cards.source_title: St. Joe Location — Bo Diddley's Deli

cards.title: Italian Dinner at Bello Cucina
cards.subtitle: Italian steakhouse in downtown Saint Joseph
cards.notes: Enjoy a sit-down Italian dinner with friends until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.short_summary: A more formal dining option in downtown St. Joseph, popular for student celebrations and weekend dinners.
cards.evidence_claim: Bello Cucina is open until 9:00 PM Tuesday-Thursday and until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM on weekends; closed Mondays.

cards.title: Late Bites at Neighbors
cards.subtitle: Casual restaurant on the edge of Saint Joseph
cards.notes: Visit for a late-night burger or appetizer, with the kitchen serving until 10:00 PM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A local grill offering a full menu for students looking for a meal just off the main campus corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The kitchen at Neighbors Route 75 is open until 9:00 PM Sunday-Thursday and 10:00 PM Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Neighbors Route 75 - Food & Drinks - St Joseph MN
cards.access_notes: Kitchen open until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Evening Projects at the Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Creative lab in Clemens Library
cards.notes: Work on creative projects or class assignments using specialized tools until 8:00 PM most weeknights.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative space for students to experiment and build, located within the main CSB library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Clemens Library Makerspace is open Monday through Thursday from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM and Sunday from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Libraries | CSB+SJU - College of Saint Benedict
